description: Gazoducs installés dans la partie belge de la Mer du Nord is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Koninklijk Belgisch Instituut voor Natuurwetenschappen (KBIN). This dataset represents the exact location of gas pipelines installed in the Belgian Part of the North Sea. Coverage: Koninklijk Belgisch Instituut voor Natuurwetenschappen (KBIN). The portal shows the English title as "Gas pipelines as built" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Koninklijk Belgisch Instituut voor Natuurwetenschappen (KBIN). Its keywords include Bundesregierung, Reporting INSPIRE, Gouvernement Fédéral, marine spatial planning, Marine essentials, Federale Overheid. The listing shows 2026-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
